cover.desc: Full color, Layer 3 palette — cel shading, hard-edged shadows, pastel field, generous negative space. Early morning, cool light. Kusaka Hibiki stands alone at the school gate with both bare hands held out, palms up, offering them to nobody — grinning enormously, blazer open, club jersey with the pale 0 slung over one shoulder, bandage across his nose, solid black spiked hair the darkest mass in frame. The entire student body flows around him in flat pastel silhouette, every single one of them with their hands in their pockets, giving him a wide berth. Behind him, pinned to the gate post, a small white card reading nothing. In the far background, small and vertical, Anzai Sumire watches from the other side of the road with her sleeves pulled over her hands — the only person facing him.

panels.bg: the front gate of Tōka Municipal High at 7:40am — cherry trees going over, a river of students in identical uniforms, bicycle racks, a teacher with a clipboard; tone-washed with two hard perspective lines
panels.action: Morning. The slate is clean. That is the problem.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: beaming, both hands out
chars.pose: standing in the middle of the gate flow with palms up like a market seller

panels.bg: the gate, students streaming past on both sides
panels.action: The morning routine of the least dangerous boy in Japan.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, arms wide
chars.pose: spinning to offer both hands in opposite directions

panels.bg: blank with speed lines, chibi crowd fleeing outward
panels.action: Word has travelled since yesterday.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, one enormous tear, thumbs still up
chars.pose: alone in a circle of empty ground

panels.action: Nine hundred students. A radius of two metres.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: cheerful again instantly, walking backwards
chars.pose: hands behind his head, jersey over one shoulder

panels.action: It has never once ruined his morning. It is a scheduling problem.

dialogue.text: Fine! I'll get you at lunch!

panels.action: The Nine, plus one.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: radiant, arms out, mid-entrance
chars.pose: kicking the shed door open with both hands already extended

panels.bg: the doorway, morning light behind him
panels.action: He does not knock either.

chars.name: rai
chars.expression: chibi, hands jammed in pockets
chars.pose: turning away

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: chibi, sitting on her own hands
chars.pose: grinning

chars.name: bin
chars.expression: chibi, flat, hands inside his sleeves
chars.pose: not moving

chars.name: hebihara

chars.pose: seated on the desk with one leg swinging

panels.action: The coach has been sitting there the whole time.

dialogue.text: You run it with the club.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: one finger raised, not smiling
chars.pose: leaning forward

panels.action: There is a condition. There is always a condition.

dialogue.text: A hand has to be offered.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: blinking, genuinely confused
chars.pose: hands frozen halfway out

panels.action: He has never had to ask before. He has always just reached.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: arms folded, serious, kind about it
chars.pose: standing over him, enormous

chars.name: shiho
chars.expression: smiling, pouring tea
chars.pose: seated

panels.action: The captain explains the thing nobody had to explain to anybody else.

dialogue.text: In a meet we're all busy.
Nobody stops to hand you a minute.
You must be worth the minute.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: flat, clipboard up, glasses two discs
chars.pose: reading out a tally

panels.action: The manager has already scored him.

chars.name: hibiki

chars.pose: up on his feet

panels.action: It takes him about a second and a half to be fine.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, watching from the doorway
chars.pose: leaning on the frame with both hands inside her sleeves

panels.bg: the shed door, morning light behind her
panels.action: One member is not part of this game and everybody knows it.

panels.bg: the practice Pit at 8:40am — empty bleachers, one bored official, the steel drum on its tripod, the black square of the Pit mouth, morning haze; tone-washed
panels.action: No crowd. No announcer. Just the drum.

dialogue.text: Judge is Mr. Anzai from maths.
He is not related to Anzai.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: grinning, hand on the drum crank
chars.pose: spinning it hard

panels.action: The drum spins even for a practice leg. That is the point of the drum.

chars.name: shiho
chars.expression: serene, hands folded
chars.pose: standing beside him

panels.action: The third-year answers without turning her head.

panels.bg: a plain white card held up in a teacher's hand, flat tone behind it
panels.action: The card comes out.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: mouth open
chars.pose: staring at the card

chars.name: rai
chars.expression: already annoyed
chars.pose: hands in pockets

panels.action: The whole club groans at once.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: pen flying, clipboard braced on one forearm
chars.pose: standing in the middle of the huddle

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: leaning in
chars.pose: hands on knees

panels.bg: the team huddle at the start line, tone-washed
panels.action: Half of this sport is the argument before the horn.

dialogue.text: So it has to have been fixed.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: hand straight up like a classroom
chars.pose: on tiptoe at the back of the huddle

panels.action: He has one question and it is not a stupid one.

dialogue.text: So I have to be RIGHT?

chars.name: rui
chars.expression: smug, camera up, filming himself
chars.pose: one hand through his hair

panels.action: Sakaki Rui has already decided how this leg goes.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: hand on the horn, sunglasses down
chars.pose: beside the start line

panels.bg: the start line, the black Pit mouth
panels.action: Six in. One of them has nothing at all.

dialogue.text: Six on the line. Kusaka runs.
Twenty minutes. Go on the horn.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: grinning enormously, crouched on the line
chars.pose: both bare palms flat on the dirt

panels.action: Nothing in the tank. Twenty minutes. He has never been happier.

panels.bg: Pit floor one — a wide pale cavern of broken stone, a collapsed steel service gantry lying across the middle like a fallen bridge, drifting dust, cold shafts of worklight; tone-washed with three hard perspective lines
panels.action: Floor one. Somebody's old gantry has been down here since before any of them were born.

dialogue.text: Spread out! Eyes on the floor!

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: grinning, chewing
chars.pose: crouching and firing straight up out of frame

panels.bg: the cavern, the gantry, dust blowing outward
panels.action: Kirin Momo goes up. Kirin Momo always goes up.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: running flat out with nothing in his hands
chars.pose: sprinting along the cavern wall

panels.bg: broken stone, worklight, Litter shapes turning toward him
panels.action: He is the slowest thing in the room and the loudest.

panels.bg: four low grey Litter coming off the nest at speed, dust flat, worklight glare
panels.action: Sixteen of them. Four of them have noticed the noisy one.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, arms and legs everywhere, X eyes
chars.pose: being comprehensively flattened by a grey shape

panels.action: This is what a Null looks like in a Pit.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, one eye shut, still cheerful
chars.pose: face down in the dirt with a thumb up

panels.action: He gets up. He always gets up. It is his entire technique.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: up on a rock, both hands cupped round his mouth
chars.pose: shouting across the whole cavern

panels.bg: the cavern floor, the club scattered across it, Litter between them
panels.action: He cannot fight. He can be heard from anywhere in the room.

dialogue.text: How is he seeing all that?

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: glasses flashing, pen stopped
chars.pose: looking up from the clipboard

panels.action: The manager notices something she was not expecting to notice.

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: grinning in midair, arms out
chars.pose: at the top of an enormous jump, above the gantry

panels.bg: the cavern roof, worklight, the gantry far below
panels.action: She is forty feet up with no way to steer.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes gone wide, tracking her arc
chars.pose: head snapping up, one arm pointing

panels.action: He is watching where she is going to come down.

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: eyes wide, twisting in the air
chars.pose: coming down onto a stone shelf that is visibly crumbling under her

panels.bg: the high shelf, a long drop behind it, dust falling
panels.action: It goes exactly the way he said it would.

panels.bg: the shelf coming apart in slabs, a small figure rolling clear onto solid rock, dust column
panels.action: Left was rock.

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: flat on her back, filthy, laughing
chars.pose: one arm over her eyes

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: arriving at a sprint
chars.pose: skidding to a stop beside her

panels.action: She is laughing before she has finished coughing.

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: grinning up at him, holding a filthy bare hand up
chars.pose: flat on her back, arm straight up

panels.action: The first offered hand of his entire life.

panels.bg: two filthy bare hands closing on each other, tone-washed, borderless
panels.action: Asked for. Out loud. Offered.

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: chibi, exasperated, sitting up
chars.pose: flapping a hand at him

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, insistent, holding her hand up like evidence
chars.pose: kneeling

panels.action: He will not proceed without the word.
The card.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes shut, teeth bared, entirely airborne
chars.pose: fired straight up off the cavern floor, arms flailing, legs already wrong

panels.bg: the cavern roof rushing at him, the gantry and the whole club shrinking below
panels.action: He has never done this before. It shows immediately.

dialogue.text: ALL OF IT! TUCK ALL OF IT!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, spinning, absolutely horizontal
chars.pose: coming down head first at speed

panels.bg: blank with speed lines, the gantry below
panels.action: Law six. He got the ability. He did not get the landing.

dialogue.text: Oh, he's going to hit the gantry.
He's going to hit the gantry.
I'M GOING TO HIT THE GANTRY

panels.bg: the fallen steel gantry, a dust cloud punched out of it, one sneaker spinning away
panels.action: He hits the gantry.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: sprawled across a steel beam, one eye shut, staring at something an inch from his nose
chars.pose: face down on the gantry

panels.action: He lands on the answer and does not know it for four more pages.

dialogue.text: It's a pin. A big one.

panels.bg: a thick steel pin joining two gantry beams, seen an inch away — a fat ugly weld bead around its middle, and a fresh bright crack running through the weld
panels.action: A pin. Welded once, in somebody's careful hand. Cracked again since.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: sitting bolt upright, eyes enormous
chars.pose: up on his knees on the beam

panels.action: Broken. Mended. Broken.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: standing on the gantry waving both arms
chars.pose: shouting down the length of the whole cavern

chars.name: shiho
chars.expression: already walking over, unhurried
chars.pose: hands folded

panels.bg: the fallen gantry running the width of the cavern, the club scattered below
panels.action: He needs a second opinion and he knows exactly whose.

dialogue.text: I NEED YOU TO LICK SOMETHING!

chars.name: shiho
chars.expression: eyes closed, serene, tongue to rusted steel
chars.pose: kneeling over the pin

panels.action: Uwabami Shiho tastes the whole history of a piece of metal.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: vibrating, both fists clenched
chars.pose: crouched opposite her

chars.name: shiho
chars.expression: smiling, wiping her mouth with a handkerchief
chars.pose: sitting back on her heels

panels.action: Two people who are extremely happy about a rusty pin.

dialogue.text: So it broke. Someone fixed it.

chars.name: shiho
chars.expression: gentle, holding out one bare hand palm up
chars.pose: offering it without being asked

panels.action: The second offered hand.

dialogue.text: You'll want to taste it yourself.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, green, tongue out, absolutely regretting it
chars.pose: recoiling from the pin

chars.name: shiho
chars.expression: chibi, delighted, clapping
chars.pose: kneeling

panels.action: He did not think through what TASTE actually involves.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: on his feet, wiping his mouth, focused
chars.pose: hammering at the pin with a chunk of rock

chars.name: gaku
chars.expression: half-lidded, arms stretched over to hold the beam
chars.pose: bracing the gantry from four metres away

panels.bg: the gantry, dust, the cavern beyond
panels.action: Fourteen minutes gone. The pin does not want to come out.

dialogue.text: All of it. It's holding all of it.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, arriving at a walk
chars.pose: stepping onto the gantry with both hands in her sleeves

panels.action: The ace has been listening from sixty metres away.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: level, looking down at the pin
chars.pose: crouched beside it, sleeve-covered hands on her knees, touching nothing

panels.action: She looks at it for exactly as long as she needs to.

dialogue.text: Pull it and the gantry drops.

panels.bg: under the gantry — the Litter nest, sixteen grey shapes in the dark, and the whole steel span hanging above them on one cracked pin
panels.action: Onto the nest. And onto whoever is standing under it.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes fully open, absolutely steady
chars.pose: standing up on the beam, feet set, sleeves pulled down

panels.bg: the gantry, the nest below, worklight raking across
panels.action: She does what she always does. She says it first.

dialogue.text: I hold the span up with my back.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: shouting, running
chars.pose: sprinting down the gantry

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: white
chars.pose: both hands on the radio

panels.action: The whole club moves at once and none of them are close enough.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: horrified, hand out toward her and stopping dead in the air
chars.pose: half-risen, arm frozen

panels.action: He could stop her by grabbing her. He is the only one close enough.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: teeth bared, eyes shut, absolutely committed
chars.pose: back and shoulders jammed under the steel span, both sleeve-covered hands braced on her thighs

panels.bg: the underside of the gantry, dust raining down, the nest stirring in the dark below
panels.action: Exactly as declared. The span stops moving.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: hammering with both hands, filthy, shouting
chars.pose: flat on his stomach on the beam, working the pin

panels.action: It gives a millimetre. Then nothing.

chars.name: rai
chars.expression: arriving at a run, chin up, furious about it
chars.pose: sliding to a stop on the beam with his right hand already out

panels.action: Dōmeki Rai said he would never offer. Dōmeki Rai is a liar.

chars.name: rai
chars.expression: scowling, absolutely not looking at him
chars.pose: bare right hand held out flat, palm up

panels.action: He does not make it a moment. That is how you can tell it is one.
The card.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: screaming, eyes shut, right hand glowing white against the steel
chars.pose: bare right palm clamped around the pin, whole body braced

panels.bg: the beam, the steel going bright, dust and smoke, Sumire's shoulders straining in the background
panels.action: He gets the ability. He does not get Rai's twelve years of practice at holding it.

dialogue.text: It's YOUR hand! It can't burn!

panels.bg: the pin glowing, the old weld softening and letting go in a bright seam
panels.action: Fifty years of somebody's careful weld gives up in nine seconds.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes shut, sweat, jaw locked, absolutely still
chars.pose: under the full weight of the span

panels.bg: steel, dust falling in a curtain
panels.action: She has not moved a centimetre. She said she would not.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: wrenching backwards with the whole of himself
chars.pose: both hands on the pin, hauling

panels.action: Three seconds left on the borrow.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: flat on his back, pin held up in both hands, howling
chars.pose: sprawled on the beam

panels.action: The pin comes out at zero.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes snapping open
chars.pose: still braced under a span that has just become two thousand kilos of nothing holding it

panels.bg: the underside of the gantry, steel beginning to fold, dust exploding outward
panels.action: The pin is out. The declaration is complete. The span is not.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat on the floor, one boot caught under folded steel
chars.pose: pinned at the ankle, twisting

panels.bg: collapsed steel, dust, the nest scattering in the dark
panels.action: Her boot is under it. She is not.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: roaring, hands out
chars.pose: arriving at a sprint and stopping dead two metres short

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: arms out, also stopping
chars.pose: skidding

panels.bg: the collapsed span, dust, the whole club arriving and halting in a ring
panels.action: Six people arrive who could pull her out in one second. Six people stop.

dialogue.text: I can lift it — Anzai, take my hand!
She'll say no all day, captain.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: completely calm, and that is the frightening part
chars.pose: lying in the dust with both hands tucked into her sleeves against her chest

panels.bg: dust, steel, borderless with tone fade-out
panels.action: Nobody in this club has ever seen her flinch. Nobody has ever seen her ask, either.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: not smiling, working, eyes moving between the steel and the captain
chars.pose: crouched, pin still in one fist

panels.action: He does not argue with her. He goes around.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: bright, certain, hand already out
chars.pose: turning to the captain with his palm up

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: blank for one second
chars.pose: enormous, still

panels.action: He asks the biggest man in the school for the one thing that will not help.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes blazing, pointing at the folded steel with the pin
chars.pose: up on his feet, gesturing at a gap under the span

panels.bg: the collapsed gantry, a shallow triangle of space beneath it, dust
panels.action: He has been looking at the shape of the wreck the entire time.

dialogue.text: Two more inches and she's stuck.
I get under it and I stop.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: staring at him, then something breaking open in his face
chars.pose: bare hand coming up

panels.action: Nobody has ever asked to be the floor before.

dialogue.text: Sixty seconds is all you get.

panels.action: The card.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: teeth bared, shoulders jammed up into folded steel
chars.pose: crouched in the triangle under the span with both feet planted wide

panels.bg: under the collapsed gantry, dust falling, steel groaning
panels.action: The smallest boy in the school becomes a bolt in the ground.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes open, looking at him from thirty centimetres away
chars.pose: flat in the dust, ankle still trapped, absolutely still

panels.bg: under the steel, dust hanging in the worklight, borderless
panels.action: They have never been this close and there is a whole hand's width of air between them.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: straining, grinning anyway, both hands flat against the steel
chars.pose: anchored, immovable, and completely unable to help her

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: working her heel out of the boot
chars.pose: twisting slowly

panels.action: He cannot reach for her. Anchored, he cannot move at all. That is the entire point.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: stopping, actually looking at him for the first time in two chapters
chars.pose: half out of the boot, propped on one elbow

panels.bg: under the steel, dust, soft worklight, tone gradient
panels.action: She works out what he has done, and it is not what she expected.

dialogue.text: Yeah. That's why I picked it.
It's the only way it works.

panels.bg: silhouette panel — two solid black figures under a black wedge of steel against a flat pale tone field, one braced upright, one lying flat, a clean band of empty white between them
panels.action: Two metres has become thirty centimetres and it is still exactly two metres.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, unhurt, one boot missing
chars.pose: rolling clear of the span in a sock

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: grabbing her jersey, not her skin
chars.pose: hauling by the fabric

panels.bg: the edge of the wreck, dust, the club crowding in
panels.action: Out at eight seconds, exactly as advertised.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes going wide, still braced, mouth open
chars.pose: under the steel, both feet planted

panels.action: He has been counting the whole time. Everyone else forgot.

dialogue.text: That's going to be a problem.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes shut, diving flat
chars.pose: throwing himself sideways out from under the span the instant his feet unstick

panels.bg: the gantry folding the last two feet, dust exploding outward across the cavern floor
panels.action: Sixty seconds, exactly. It has still never waited for him.

dialogue.text: I've got him. I've got him.

chars.name: gaku
chars.expression: half-lidded, unbothered
chars.pose: three metres of arm hooked round Hibiki's middle, dragging him clear

panels.action: Hozumi Gaku did not offer his hand. Hozumi Gaku used it.

panels.bg: sixteen grey Litter boiling out of the wrecked nest in every direction across the cavern floor
panels.action: And now the nest is awake and homeless.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: standing in one boot and one sock, entirely level
chars.pose: walking forward through the dust

panels.action: She is not even slightly finished.

dialogue.text: I clear the line to the horn.
In one sock. Watch your feet.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes wide, teeth bared, absolutely enjoying herself
chars.pose: mid-stride through the swarm, one leg coming up and through

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: planted, laughing
chars.pose: anchored in the middle of the floor as Litter bounce off him

panels.bg: the cavern floor, dust, sixteen grey shapes coming apart, worklight raking
panels.action: The Nine do the thing the Nine are actually good at.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: sprinting flat out with the pin held over his head
chars.pose: running for the start line through the middle of it all

panels.bg: the cavern, the Pit mouth ahead, chaos behind
panels.action: He has nothing left to borrow and one job.

chars.name: bin
chars.expression: flat, headphones down, walking alongside him
chars.pose: hands in pockets, keeping pace exactly

panels.bg: the cavern, a strange ring of total silence around them
panels.action: Numata Bin turns the volume off and the whole world stops hearing them.

chars.name: bin
chars.expression: completely deadpan
chars.pose: not looking at him

panels.action: Nobody can hear anything, which is the joke.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: howling, pin over his head, filthy
chars.pose: crossing the start line at a dead sprint

panels.bg: the start line, the official's table, the Pit mouth behind him
panels.action: Nineteen minutes and forty seconds.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: filthy, one shoe gone, holding the pin out in both hands
chars.pose: standing at the official's table, absolutely radiant

panels.bg: the official's table, the empty bleachers, morning light
panels.action: The other half of this sport. The argument.

dialogue.text: Judge is going to say no.
Judge is going to say no.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: flat, glasses two discs, delivering bad news efficiently
chars.pose: clipboard up

panels.action: The manager has watched two hundred of these.

dialogue.text: You have to prove the first break.
Anyone can crack a pin today.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: grinning enormously, absolutely ready
chars.pose: putting the pin down on the table with a bang

panels.action: He has been waiting twenty minutes to say this.

dialogue.text: That's a weld bead. Field weld.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: leaning in over the table, one finger on the pin
chars.pose: pointing at the seam

panels.bg: the pin on the table, tone-washed
panels.action: He does not have an ability. He has an afternoon of somebody else's life in his mouth.

dialogue.text: You don't weld a good pin.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: absolutely certain, both palms flat on the table
chars.pose: leaning across it

panels.bg: the table, the club behind him
panels.action: Break one. The mend. Break two.

panels.bg: the official's table, a maths teacher in a cardigan turning a rusted pin over twice in the morning light while an entire club holds its breath
panels.action: Eleven seconds. It feels considerably longer.

chars.name: hibiki

chars.pose: airborne over the whole club

chars.expression: chibi, roaring

chars.name: hebihara

panels.action: The coach does the only tally that matters to her.

panels.action: He answers honestly, which is the only way he knows.

chars.pose: both arms up

dialogue.text: Card on the board! Ninth this year!

chars.name: gaku

chars.pose: beside him

dialogue.text: You know it's a reserve number.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: glasses flashing, pen absolutely flying

panels.action: The manager has been writing since the horn.

chars.name: rai
chars.expression: chin up, aggressively casual, not making eye contact
chars.pose: leaning on the doorframe

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: beaming at him
chars.pose: twisted round on the sofa

panels.action: Dōmeki Rai would like it noted that this meant nothing.

dialogue.text: I gave you a hot pin. Different.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, both hands clasped
chars.pose: leaning after him

chars.name: rai
chars.expression: chibi, walking away fast
chars.pose: hands in pockets

panels.action: Eight down. One to go, and everybody knows which one.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, one boot and one sock, sitting apart on the equipment crate
chars.pose: eating a rice ball out of the wrapper without touching it

panels.bg: the corner of the shed, the noise happening across the room
panels.action: She eats through the wrapper. She has always eaten through the wrapper.

dialogue.text: You could just say thank you.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: level, looking at nothing in particular
chars.pose: wrapper held in two sleeve-covered hands

panels.action: She has already said it once today and nobody heard.

dialogue.text: He told me not to make it weird.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: serious, taping a sheet to the whiteboard
chars.pose: standing on a chair

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: arms folded in the doorway
chars.pose: watching the room

panels.bg: the whiteboard, the whole club turning to look at once
panels.action: The thing everybody has been not-mentioning all morning.

dialogue.text: Ranked. It goes on our record.
It went up an hour ago.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: bright, elbowing forward through everybody
chars.pose: shoving to the front of the crowd at the board

panels.bg: the whiteboard, the club packed around it
panels.action: Six names. He reads them twice.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: smiling, and it is a completely genuine smile, which is worse
chars.pose: hands behind his head

panels.bg: the shed, the board out of focus behind him
panels.action: He is not on it. He is not remotely surprised.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: sunglasses down, absolutely level
chars.pose: in the doorway with the light behind her

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: still smiling
chars.pose: turned toward her

panels.bg: the shed, the club very carefully looking at other things
panels.action: The coach says the hard thing plainly, because he would rather have it plainly.

dialogue.text: You'd have to touch six of them.
In the box. Before the horn.
Then run out of them by minute four.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: nodding, absolutely reasonable about it
chars.pose: hands in his pockets

panels.action: He has run this arithmetic himself, on the way back from the line.

panels.bg: silhouette panel — a small solid black figure alone in the middle of a flat pale tone field, hands in pockets, shoulders up, and eight black figures behind him all turned toward him
panels.action: Nobody in the room says the obvious kind thing, because it would not be true.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: glasses flashing, holding the clipboard against her chest
chars.pose: stepping in front of him

panels.action: The manager has a problem and one idea, and she hates the idea.

dialogue.text: The maths only fails one way.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: looking up, pen stopping
chars.pose: one finger on a line of her own diagram

panels.action: She is looking at the crowd column.

dialogue.text: Unless you don't only use us.

panels.bg: the school gate at four in the afternoon — long light, cherry blossom on the ground, the river of students gone, one bicycle left in the rack
panels.action: End of the day. Everything he had is used up and gone.

dialogue.text: All four asked for. Out loud.
And tomorrow it's all gone again.
Which is fine. That's the job.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, waiting, in two boots again
chars.pose: standing at the gate post with both hands in her sleeves

panels.action: She has been standing there for eleven minutes.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, both hands snapped behind his back, sweating
chars.pose: standing to attention

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: chibi, flat, unimpressed
chars.pose: arms at her sides

panels.action: He has learned exactly one thing this week.

dialogue.text: I'm being SO normal about it!

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: level, direct, entirely serious
chars.pose: looking straight at him

panels.bg: the gate post, long light, tone gradient
panels.action: She did not come here to thank him. She came here to give him an order.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: absolutely flat, and it lands like a hammer
chars.pose: turning to go, one sleeve-covered hand raised slightly

panels.action: She says it the way she says everything: like it has already happened.

dialogue.text: Not one person. Save all of it.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: half-turned back, and for one panel there is something under the flat
chars.pose: walking away, not looking at him

panels.action: She does not explain. She has never explained anything in her life.
